_comment: Regression ratchet for `vue-tsc --noEmit` in packages/client. total_errors is a CEILING, not a target: CI fails when the count rises above it. Lower it whenever you fix errors; never raise it without saying why in the PR. Regenerate with scripts/ci/check_client_type_check_ratchet.py --log <log> --write-baseline.
_witness: Measured 2026-08-19 on main + the six macro-import fixes, under the real toolchain (vue-tsc 3.3.10, typescript 6.0.3). History: the ceiling was 150 under vue-tsc 2.x, rose to 156 when vue-tsc 2->3 surfaced six TS2440 macro-import defects, and returns to 150 now those are fixed. The post-fix error set is IDENTICAL to the original vue-tsc-2 set (0 differences in either direction), so the six were removed and nothing was traded for them. Isolation note: typescript 5.9.3 vs 6.0.3 on one tree with vue-tsc held constant produced byte-identical sets - TS6 contributed zero errors.
_known_hotspot: 63 of 150 errors come from src/views/cam/headstock/ (4 files), which is ORPHANED: zero inbound imports, absent from the router, and importing 11 modules that do not exist. `vite build` never sees it (not in the graph) but vue-tsc type-checks it because tsconfig include covers all of src with no exclude. Tracked as MAINT-DEFER-010. If removed, re-run --write-baseline; the ceiling should drop to about 87.
